units.source_text: 署長寫完檔案後說：「至於是否起訴你，得由檢察官來裁決。

en.t: After finishing the file, the chief said, "As for whether you will be prosecuted, that will be decided by the prosecutor.

units.source_text: 你最好發電報或打電話通知你的擔保人，讓他們今天到橫濱檢察局來一趟。

en.t: You had better notify your guarantor by telegram or telephone and have them come to the Yokohama prosecutor's office today.

units.source_text: 你應該有擔保人和監護人吧？」

en.t: You must have a guarantor or guardian, don't you?"

units.source_text: 我猛然想起一位叫澀田的書畫古董商，他經常出入父親的別墅，跟我是同鄉，

en.t: I suddenly remembered an art and antiques dealer named Shibuta, who often came and went at my father's villa and came from the same hometown as I did,

units.source_text: 經常迎和並討好我父親，長得又矮又胖，都不惑之年了還是個光棍，他就是我在學校上學的保證人。

en.t: He was always flattering and currying favor with my father, short and fat, still a bachelor past forty, and he was my guarantor for school.

units.source_text: 他長著一張很特別的臉，尤其是眼睛，酷似比目魚，所以父親總是叫他比目魚，我也跟著這麼叫。

en.t: He had a very distinctive face, especially his eyes, which looked just like a flounder's, so my father always called him Flounder, and I called him that too.
